title: Zuno Agent Definition (OKF v0.2 + Zuno extension)
description: Schema for agents/<name>/agent.okf.yaml. Per ADR-0005, Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2 is the base representation for agent knowledge/context and portability: it fixes the envelope (apiVersion/kind/metadata) and the general notion of a portable, declarative agent definition, but it does not prescribe Zuno's runtime concerns (tasks, tool authorization, model routing hints, UI presentation). Per ADR-0006, Zuno defines a profile on top of bare OKF for exactly those runtime concerns. Fields are annotated below as [OKF CORE] (part of the bare OKF v0.2 envelope any OKF-consuming tool would recognize) or [ZUNO EXT] (the Zuno profile: this repository's agent-platform-specific extension, all nested under `spec`, that OKF v0.2 explicitly leaves to implementers). This schema is the Track E contract other tracks (frontend portal rendering, policy/tool authorization, evaluation harness) can validate `agent.okf.yaml` files against.

apiVersion.description: [OKF CORE] OKF envelope version this document conforms to.

kind.description: [OKF CORE] Document kind. Always Agent for agent.okf.yaml files.

metadata.description: [OKF CORE] Identity metadata for the agent, in the sense OKF prescribes for any portable knowledge/agent bundle (a stable name and a human-readable label), plus one Zuno lifecycle field.

name.description: [OKF CORE] Stable, unique agent identifier. Matches the agents/<name> directory, the Keycloak OIDC client prefix (<name>-frontend), and the namespace suffix (zuno-<name>).

description.description: [OKF CORE] One or two sentence summary of what the agent does, independent of any particular UI.

status.description: [ZUNO EXT] Lifecycle status of this agent instance in the current release. `active` means a real Agent Runtime task graph, FE and BFF are deployed and reachable. `placeholder` means only this declarative definition and a reserved namespace exist (ADR-0007): the portal renders an access-gated "coming soon" tile and no FE/BFF Deployment is applied. See platform/architecture/agent-platform-separation.md.

spec.description: [ZUNO EXT] The Zuno profile: everything OKF v0.2 leaves unspecified that the Zuno Agent Runtime, BFF, portal and policy engine need at runtime.

tasks.description: [ZUNO EXT] Ordered list of tasks this agent exposes. A `placeholder` agent declares exactly one stub task with an empty tool list.

name.description: Task identifier, kebab-case, unique within the agent (e.g. answer-technical-question).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what invoking this task does.

allowed_tools.description: MCP tool names this task may invoke, drawn from the platform tool-policy vocabulary (policies/tools/README.md). Effective authorization is the intersection of this list with the user's group/task/data-classification policy (ADR-0011) — this field is a ceiling, not a grant on its own. Empty for placeholder agents.

model.description: [ZUNO EXT] Model routing hint consumed by the AI/Inference Gateway (ADR-0009, ADR-0021): the data-classification ceiling this agent's tasks operate under, not a specific model name.

preferred_classification.description: Highest data classification this agent is routed for. C1: SaaS model use allowed. C2: SaaS allowed with restrictions/context filtering. C3: local models only. See policies/data-classification/README.md.

notes.description: Optional free-text routing guidance (e.g. sovereignty constraints on a subset of tasks).

access.description: [ZUNO EXT] Authorization gate consumed by the portal and BFF: which Keycloak realm groups may open this agent's tile / call its BFF.

groups.description: Keycloak `zuno` realm groups (JWT `groups` claim, e.g. "/consultant") authorized to use this agent. One group per agent for v0; the schema allows more than one for forward compatibility.

ui.description: [ZUNO EXT] Presentation metadata the portal frontend uses to render this agent's tile, independent of whether the agent is active or placeholder.

displayName.description: Short name shown on the portal tile (may differ from metadata.displayName's fuller form).

tileDescription.description: One-line description shown under the tile title.

color.description: Hint for the tile's accent color. A CSS color keyword or #rrggbb hex value.

icon.description: Hint for the tile's icon: a short keyword the frontend maps to a PatternFly/pf-icon glyph (e.g. "code", "currency", "drafting-compass", "handshake", "calculator"). Not a URL or file path.
